name: cursor-bridge
description: Lets Claude start and monitor Cursor CLI agents on this PC, each in its own git worktree of the dooh-dsp repo.
long_description: Starts headless Cursor agents for task files in the dooh-dsp repo. Every agent runs in a separate git worktree next to the repo, so your own working copy is never touched. Jobs run in the background with a log each; Claude can check status, read output, stop a job and clean up worktrees. Requires the Cursor CLI (agent) to be installed and logged in.

repo.title: dooh-dsp repo folder
repo.description: Your local clone of the dooh-dsp repo. Cursor agents work in git worktrees created next to it.

cursor_agent_path.title: Cursor CLI path (optional)
cursor_agent_path.description: Leave blank to find it automatically. Only set this if the Cursor CLI lives somewhere unusual.

max_jobs.title: Max parallel Cursor agents
max_jobs.description: How many Cursor agents may run at once.

tools.name: cursor_check
tools.description: Health check of the repo, Cursor CLI and login, with an optional test prompt.

tools.name: cursor_login
tools.description: Start the Cursor CLI login and return the approval link.

tools.name: cursor_start_task
tools.description: Start a Cursor agent on a task file in its own git worktree.

tools.name: cursor_start
tools.description: Start a Cursor agent with a free-form prompt in its own git worktree.

tools.name: cursor_status
tools.description: List jobs or show one job's status and recent log.

tools.name: cursor_output
tools.description: Read the last lines of a job's output.
